task: One-scan spatial spectral-contrast reconstruction; held-repeat proxy, not magnetic-field truth
target: Equal mean of reference A/B; references never predictor inputs

final_bootstrap.unit: Whole acquisition file, paired across methods; six files, no independent-population claim

seeds: Root supplies immutable fresh training/bootstrap seeds before signal release. No seeds or measurements generated by preparation.
limits: All acquisition repeats stay in the same outer group.
Repeats lack verified timestamps; independence and stationarity are assumptions.
Same apparatus/FOV, current-time confounding and repeated spatial structure remain.
No sensor-speed, field-truth, FPGA, hardware, or neural novelty claim.
Stop before training if qualification fails. Never reinterpret old consumed evaluations as new tests.
scope: Freeze A eligibility implementation only; later decoder/reference implementation requires prospective root review, not permission from this file

roi.observation: Repeat0 first10+last10 frequency frames, mean fluorescence image
roi.crowding: Reject both close components, never select the brighter one
roi.ordering: centroid y then x; no ranking by brightness or reference outcomes
roi.label_footprint: Observed connected component dilated once by 3x3 footprint, strictly inside fixed9x9 ROI

registration.mode: Each frequency frame in every repeat separately; intensity-only translation against repeat0 endpoint template at observed ROI pixels
registration.similarity: Normalized mean-centered fluorescence correlation over selected ROI pixels
registration.failed_frame_action: Use zero shift, retain spectrum and failure flag; never remove selected sites
registration.reference_separation: Reference shifts affect reference targets only; no reference shift/template/scale enters repeat0 inputs
registration.limit: Global translation with bounded quadratic subpixel correction and bilinear sampling; no local drift or rotation; fixed +/-1-pixel reference sensitivity quantifies remaining registration uncertainty.
registration.subpixel: If the best integer shift is interior, apply separable three-point parabolic correlation-peak refinement, then bilinear sampling; clamp each refinement to0.5px and require total shift within2px. Flat curvature uses zero refinement. No spectral comparison selects shifts.
registration.ambiguity: Best/second integer margin<0.002 is reported, never by itself a failure
registration.registration_residual: Report2*(1-correlation) after subpixel refinement; retain correlation>=0.90 gate
registration.sensitivity: Opposing +/-1px perturbations of A versus B, four axial choices; every covariance lower95%>0 and point reliability>=0.25

normalization: One scalar for the entire acquisition: median repeat0 endpoint fluorescence over the fixed crop. Apply it to all observed/reference spectra. Save scale. No per-reference or per-spot scale; no reference-derived correction enters predictor inputs.

contrast.smoothing: Normalized Gaussian sigma3MHz radius9MHz, valid convolution
contrast.spatial: Center over every selected spot in the acquisition; recenter within each bootstrap resample
contrast.physical_scope: Broad ODMR-like spectral structure, source paper mean FWHM16MHz. Not a field label or complete resonance test.

eligibility.unit: Each file separately; whole occupied128x128-pixel superblocks; weighted spot count with recentering
eligibility.uncertainty: Conditional within-FOV spatial bootstrap; not independent acquisition replication

candidate_preparation: After eligibility: one direct spatial-spectral decoder, training mean feasible, CUDA, fixed capacity/seed, inner-training holdout stopping. No decoder architecture is frozen by this eligibility-only source.
classical_preparation: Same observed ROI geometry/calibration/context for all. Mean/location templates, robust low-rank/Wiener, edge-preserving and spatial physical references. Do not smooth across different randomly oriented crystals. Root reviews optimized implementations before development.
prior_exposure: Custodian must record prior byte reads and decoding separately. f1/f12 had short range reads; both are training files. Do not claim their bytes were pristine.
custody_evidence_rule: Reject known prior signal decoding or missing audit evidence. Preserve no record of decoding as uncertainty, not proof of never decoded. Prior byte reads and audit limitations stay explicit.
